_comment: PFLOTRAN generic discoveries - applies to PFLOTRAN calibration across cases
_source: adapter-kit v0.1 seed (ai-draft) derived from the 10 mechanisms in models/pflotran/curated_seed.yaml (each carrying its own file:line `source`). 8 of 10 taken; Seepage_Face_Boundary and Aqueous_Speciation are DECK-specific (they cite pflotran.in and the miniLEO 16-component/104-species set) and belong to the case, not to model-level knowledge. Seed YAML reviewed by the PI 2026-08-19; the per-entry wording here is ai-draft and NOT separately curated.
_affects_convention: affects lists output-variable names (PFLOTRAN observation names) or process axes

discoveries.name: TST mineral kinetics has TWO rate routines and the deck picks one implicitly
discoveries.description: Transition-state-theory rate law. The volumetric rate is -(reactive surface area) x (affinity factor) x (rate constant), in mol/sec per m^3 bulk [src: reaction_mineral.F90:1274-1281]. TWO DISTINCT RATE ROUTINES EXIST and the deck selects between them implicitly -- see the AFFINITY_THRESHOLD entry.
discoveries.discovered_by: adapter-kit v0.1 seed (derived from models/pflotran/curated_seed.yaml mechanisms)
discoveries.action: Check which routine AFFINITY_THRESHOLD selects before attributing a rate mismatch to the rate constant.

discoveries.name: Reactive surface area is not static -- it evolves with porosity and mineral volume fraction
discoveries.description: Specific surface area evolves with porosity and/or mineral volume fraction through SURFACE_AREA_FUNCTION. The porosity factor uses the SOLID fraction, ((1-phi_base)/(1-phi_0))**power [src: reaction_mineral.F90:2052-2055], so its sign of effect is opposite to the naive reading of its name.
discoveries.discovered_by: adapter-kit v0.1 seed (derived from models/pflotran/curated_seed.yaml mechanisms)
discoveries.action: SURFACE_AREA_FUNCTION couples area to state; calibrating a rate constant against a fixed-area assumption misattributes the feedback.

discoveries.name: Mineral volume change updates porosity ABSOLUTELY, and porosity then rescales permeability
discoveries.description: Mineral volume change updates porosity absolutely [src: realization_subsurface.F90:2226-2227], and porosity then rescales permeability through a thresholded power law with a LOWER clamp [src: realization_subsurface.F90:2062-2070]. The source contains NO kozeny or carman string, so naming it Kozeny-Carman would be an invention.
discoveries.discovered_by: adapter-kit v0.1 seed (derived from models/pflotran/curated_seed.yaml mechanisms)
discoveries.action: A reaction parameter therefore moves FLOW. Treat outflow misfit as potentially chemical, not only hydraulic.

discoveries.name: Van Genuchten n is DERIVED from m (n = 1/(1-m)), not an independent parameter
discoveries.description: Capillary-pressure/saturation relation. Pc = (Se**(-1/m) - 1)**(1/n) / alpha, with n = 1/(1-m) DERIVED from m and Se = (Sl - Sr)/(1 - Sr) [src: characteristic_curves_common.F90:860-867]. At or below Sr the capillary pressure is clamped to pcmax [src: characteristic_curves_common.F90:852-854].
discoveries.discovered_by: adapter-kit v0.1 seed (derived from models/pflotran/curated_seed.yaml mechanisms)
discoveries.action: Never calibrate n and m as two free parameters -- they are one degree of freedom.

discoveries.name: Liquid and gas relative permeability take SEPARATE parameter copies
discoveries.description: Relative permeability of liquid and gas derived from the retention curve. The liquid and gas forms take SEPARATE parameter copies -- in this deck MUALEM_VG_LIQ and MUALEM_VG_GAS each carry their own M and LIQUID_RESIDUAL_SATURATION [deck: pflotran.in:574-583].
discoveries.discovered_by: adapter-kit v0.1 seed (derived from models/pflotran/curated_seed.yaml mechanisms)
discoveries.source: characteristic_curves_common.F90:148-157 (liq type), :159-165 (gas type), :3366-3417 (gas rel-perm, formula at :3409); deck addresses at pflotran.in:574-583
discoveries.action: Changing the liquid copy alone leaves the gas branch on its old value; set both or state why not.

discoveries.name: GIRT solves chemistry and transport TOGETHER (global-implicit), not operator-split
discoveries.description: Global-implicit reactive transport -- chemistry and transport solved together, as opposed to operator-split OSRT. Selected in this deck [deck: pflotran.in:19].
discoveries.discovered_by: adapter-kit v0.1 seed (derived from models/pflotran/curated_seed.yaml mechanisms)
discoveries.action: Convergence behaviour and timestep sensitivity differ from OSRT; do not carry OSRT intuition across.

discoveries.name: Diffusion is modified by tortuosity when USE_MILLINGTON_QUIRK_TORTUOSITY is on
discoveries.description: Solute flux from Darcy advection, mechanical dispersion and molecular diffusion. With USE_MILLINGTON_QUIRK_TORTUOSITY the diffusion coefficient is scaled by saturation**(7/3) * porosity**(1/3) [src: transport.F90:113-114, :157-165]. That option additionally REQUIRES every TORTUOSITY to remain at its default of 1 [src: pm_rt.F90:469-483].
discoveries.discovered_by: adapter-kit v0.1 seed (derived from models/pflotran/curated_seed.yaml mechanisms)
discoveries.action: The effective diffusion coefficient is then saturation-dependent -- a fitted diffusivity absorbs that if the switch is ignored.

discoveries.name: MAX_TS_CUTS is a PER-TIMESTEP consecutive budget that resets, not a run-wide total
discoveries.description: Timestep sizing and cutting. DIAGNOSTIC, never calibration. MAX_TS_CUTS is a PER-TIMESTEP CONSECUTIVE budget -- the counter resets at the top of every timestep [src: timestepper_SNES.F90:371] and the field is documented as "Maximum number of timestep cuts within one time step" [src: timestepper_base.F90:32]. The `cuts` figure in an end-of-run summary is a LIFETIME total and is UNRELATED to this limit. A genuine exhaustion aborts with exit status 88 [src: timestepper_base.F90:740-746; pflotran_constants.F90:63 EXIT_FAILURE = 88] and writes a `<pmname>_cut_to_failure` snapshot [src: timestepper_base.F90:764].
discoveries.discovered_by: adapter-kit v0.1 seed (derived from models/pflotran/curated_seed.yaml mechanisms)
discoveries.action: DIAGNOSTIC, never a calibration parameter. Reading it as a run-wide budget mis-diagnoses cut storms.
